Marketing Analyst Intern (Summer 2026)
Northwind Foods, Austin, TX

About us
Northwind Foods makes snacks sold in 1,200 grocery stores across Texas.

What you'll do
- Pull weekly sales and social media data and build simple dashboards
- Analyze campaign results and present findings to the brand team
- Help plan A/B tests for email and social campaigns

What you'll need
- Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics or a related field
- Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups)
- Experience with SQL
- Clear written and verbal communication

Nice to have
- Experience with Tableau or Google Analytics
- Experience creating social media content

Location: Austin, TX (hybrid, 3 days in office). Pay: $22/hour.
Northwind Foods is an equal opportunity employer.
